svg.title: Qwen and Nanbeige custom text benchmark comparison
svg.desc: EQ rubric mean: Qwen 4.30/20, Nanbeige 5.57/20, ten scenarios each. Retail outcomes: both eight passed tasks out of ten. Separate zero-based scales. One trial, all failures retained; not official leaderboard scores or an audio benchmark.
